value.rationale: Provides a physically motivated minimal-state memory diagnostic and a sharp counterintuitive occupancy reversal: for a two-stage center holding time the disfavored branch gains mass precisely above the explicit threshold r(r+a)>k², with unique closed-form optimizer.
